text.tspan: Here's what Rice has been building:
AI agent for a glycomaterials research platform. I gather needs directly from domain scientists
and run two build–feedback rounds before a Dec 2026 prototype handoff. Follows GlycoGPT (2023–24).
Privacy-first mobile app (Expo, on-device SQLite, no server): log meals, workouts, body data, and
supplements by text, voice, or photo; an LLM router files each note through eval-tested handlers.
BYO Claude/OpenAI/DeepSeek key · Apple Health sync · 15 languages · next: on-device agent + MCP
Do agents that represent different people keep their diversity when they deliberate, or drift
toward the base model? Multi-vendor runs + interpretability, done as “vibe research”: Claude Code
and Codex run the experiments behind human gates and blind reviews → preprint draft in 3 days.
Cross-vendor agent hub (Paperclip, MCP) · memory system for Claude · Whisper STT · AI news digest
1:1 coffee chats at Usdan + a Discord for tech, AI education, and discussion; skeptics welcome.
Presented at The Brandeis Pitch 2026; next: workshops and a pre/post attitude survey.
COSI 104a Intro to ML: designed Python, PyTorch, and JAX assignments, gave lectures, and had
students reflect on learning with AI.
“Meta Research” talk for Brandeis PhD students
— API docs → 443 validated agent tools from 744 endpoints; 70 via MCP
— API extraction, tool generation, and error diagnosis on 167 API docs
— ML for multistage mass spectra; presented at ACS 2023
— Neo4j Prize, LLM Hackathon for Materials & Chemistry
Claude Code · Codex · MCP · multi-agent · RAG · LoRA/PEFT · PyTorch · JAX · TypeScript · Slurm
PhD CS, Brandeis (May 2027) · BS Financial Math, Soochow · visiting student, UC Berkeley
Rice is always up for a coffee chat about agents, teaching, or AI and people.
